claim: DeepLinkManager routes settings links to internal PreferencesFragment instances, while a profile navigation callback is explicitly posted to AndroidUtilities.runOnUIThread.

claim: StandardHTTPRequest wraps HttpURLConnection synchronously: the builder defaults to GET and 10-second timeouts, supports headers/body/method, and build() opens the output stream and writes a supplied body; request() reads success/error streams, special-cases HTTP 429, and disconnects in finally.
recipe: Run both build() and request() off the UI thread when a body may be set (build writes it synchronously); set Content-Type explicitly, handle Http429Exception and IOException, and dispatch UI updates back to main.

recipe: Use a background queue for file logging and verify build gates before expecting diagnostics in a release build.
